text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Racecourse is abuzz with<n>cheers for the
Mejiro runners, proof<n>of the great expectations
they've<n>shouldered on their path to this<n>moment.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But what does it mean to face your<n>fans? Ines
Fujin watches the Mejiro<n>racers intently, hoping to
learn what it<n>takes to answer fans' expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Ines to take on the two<n>powerhouses
Mejiro Ryan and<n>Mejiro McQueen. The spring
Tenno<n>Sho awaits!
